intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
Test a scientific human cellular-chimera concept through dual cell-line evidence while preserving an ordinary integrated human body.

Create a photorealistic science-editorial scene inside a storm-lit mobile genomics clinic built into an alpine seed vault. An unmistakably adult woman derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair stands at a multispectral tissue scanner. Her body is anatomically coherent and naturally human. She places one normal hand beneath the scanner while an adjacent translucent anatomical projection reveals two interwoven fluorescent cell-line distributions in different colors across the same organs; paired microscope slides and a dual-origin cell lineage diagram reinforce the scientific human-chimera context. Her calm concentration, practical field coat, realistic skin, and complete human silhouette remain clearly readable. Seed drawers, wet rock, cable bundles, and lightning beyond a narrow window add complexity. Frame a three-quarter environmental portrait with the woman and the dual-lineage projection equally legible, using cool laboratory light, brief white storm flashes, and restrained documentary color.
